07 AZURE FUNCTIONS · ZERO-WASTE LAB

Every offcut, accounted for.

Server-verified leftovers, colour harmony, deep layout search, community pooling and printable packets. Only derived shapes and settings leave your device.

READY
01 · LEFTOVER CHAIN

What else can I make?

After your first project, the server plans further complete products from the exact offcuts left behind — and re-validates every cut.

02 · COLOUR HARMONY

No twin patches side by side.

Interchangeable cuts are swapped between slots to maximise CIELAB contrast between neighbours. Cut positions never move.

03 · DEEP SEARCH

Keep the biggest offcut whole.

Seeded multi-start restarts of the validated engine look for a layout that places more cuts or leaves a larger reusable rectangle.

04 · IMPACT

What this project saves.

05 · COMMUNITY POOL

Pool scraps with a friend.

Combine your photo with a donor’s — each keeps its own scale — and see whether pooling unlocks a bigger project.

06 · MAKE & SHARE

Print it. Share it.

Run the lab to render the server’s design map — the validated, colour-arranged layout an image model can be conditioned on.
